name: Current client debt
description: A comprehensive policy and process guide covering the management of current client debt within MSD, including debt establishment, types, repayment negotiation, recovery maximums, write-off criteria and processes, provisional write-offs, debt review, transfer between benefits, debt at cancellation, third party and non-beneficiary debt, and related system processes (TRACE, SWIFTT).

attributes.summary: Covers all aspects of managing client debt for MSD including establishing debt, negotiating repayments, recovery limits, write-off criteria and delegation, provisional write-offs, debt on cancelled/suspended records, review of decisions, debt repayment protection, and specific scenarios such as accident compensation, overseas absence, and self-employed clients.
steps: Determining debt types retained in TRACE
Applying debt recovery maximum and SWIFTT process maximum debt recovery
Processing debt write-off decision with delegation levels
Managing provisional write-off for debts resulting from error
Processing debt on cancelled or suspended records
Managing third party and non-beneficiary debt
Handling self-employed and commission-based client scenarios
attributes.triggers: Client receives benefit payment, debt is established, benefit rate changes, benefit is cancelled or suspended, review of decision is requested, hardship is claimed, client fails to advise of absence overseas
attributes.inputs: Client benefit records, TRACE system data, payment information, client circumstances, hardship claims, review requests, accident compensation details
attributes.outputs: Debt establishment, repayment arrangements, write-off decisions, provisional write-offs, debt transfers, debt recovery suspensions, Debt Repayment Protection arrangements, third party debt records, benefit arrears allocation
attributes.decision_points: Is debt the result of an error?, Did client intentionally contribute to the debt?, Was money received in good faith?, Has client changed their position?, Is write-off inequitable in all circumstances?, Should debt be provisionally written off?, Is debt at cancellation recoverable?, Should debt recovery be suspended due to hardship?, Is client eligible for Debt Repayment Protection?
